## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ac204886c44d6e03cc7bb775094e5145ae0a58c7`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0050-form-layout-vs-presentation.md, docs/adr/README.md + scripts/adr-index.mjs (the generator the README claims to be the output of), packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts (`FormViewSchema.type`, the ADR's first consumer), ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx + ObjectFormContainer.tsx (the renderer half), .github/workflows/lint.yml + package.json (`check:adr-index` is report-only), card #26553 comments 6458958232 / 6464456446 / 6688244732 / 6688746866, ruling 6464210455 on #27032, cards #27155 / #27159 and their PRs #27229 / #27305

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set: unchanged — right.** The net diff against merge-base `1aeeafd9` is two files under `docs/adr/**` (+4/-4); no `packages/**` path, no `exports` map, no `.d.ts`. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body is right.
- **Governed register (ADR surface): ADR-0050 moves Proposed → Accepted — right.** The maintainer's ruling 6464210455 on #27032 (A′, 「其他同意」, 2026-10-28) accepts the record; the director seat's pointer 6464456446 on #26553 prescribes the exact sentence for this closeout PR. Line 3 of the record opens with that sentence verbatim: `**Status**: Accepted (2026-10-28, letter A′ on #27032, ruling record 6464210455) — cutover card #27155 (spec) + #27159 (renderer); the 2026-10-20 amendment stands`.
- **Index keyword and counts — right.** `scripts/adr-index.mjs` `statusKeywordOf` strips the markdown emphasis, backtick and blockquote characters, then takes the vocabulary entry with the lowest index within `KEYWORD_WINDOW = 80`; `Accepted` sits at index 0, and the retained `Amended` sits past index 150, outside the window and later anyway. Summary table Proposed 5 → 4, Accepted 130 → 131, Total 149 unchanged: exactly one record moved keyword and no other record's status line differs between the merge-base and head, nor between the merge-base and `main` `acd190b2` (empty `git diff` on `docs/adr/*.md` status lines and on README.md).
- **Index row — right, derived by hand from the generator.** No `**Date**`/`Decided` header field in the first 40 lines, so `date` falls back to the first ISO date in the status value: `2026-10-28`. `statusCell` drops the keyword, unwraps the leading parenthesis and cuts the detail with `cell(detail, 64)` = 63 chars + `…`; the 63-char prefix of `2026-10-28, letter A′ on #27032, ruling record 6464210455 — cutover …` ends at `— cut`, giving the committed cell `Accepted — 2026-10-28, letter A′ on #27032, ruling record 6464210455 — cut…`. Supersedes/Superseded-by stay `—` (no such fields, no `superseded` word in the value). Line 123 of the head README is byte-for-byte that row.
- **CI reading of the same fact.** `pnpm check:adr-index` is `--self-test && --report` and never reds (lint.yml L697–700, `continue-on-error: true`), so its green is not currency evidence on its own; but the step `ADR index is current (report-only …)` in check-run `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (127983466962) completed with zero `::warning` annotations on this head (the only annotation is the ubuntu-latest notice), which is the `--report` verdict that the committed index equals the rendering and every record parsed. The dev's `--check` exit 0 is the PR body's account and is not relied on.
- **No other surface is implied.** The record's Decision / Migration / Consequences text, the Consumers line and the 2026-10-20 note under Decision 2 are untouched.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` label is on the PR (`documentation`, `size/xs`, `skip-changeset`); `Check Changeset` check-run success. `docs/adr/**` ships in no released package, so nothing is published and no changeset is owed — matches the diff. `Clause-②: no` — right; this is not the narrowing face (the narrowing itself shipped under #27229 / #27305 with their own declarations).

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions: []` — none to answer.
- Dev deviations (3): `git fetch --deepen` for the neighbour check, PR-event subscription instead of polling, worktree kept until CI is read — none touches the committed tree. Answered: no effect on the review.
- Neighbour flag: four open PRs touch `docs/adr/` records (#30828, #30862, #30899, #30940), none touches README.md; `main` has not moved a status line since the merge-base, so no regeneration is owed today. Whichever lands later re-runs `pnpm adr:index` (the lint step only warns on a stale index). Answered.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` — no login note owed.
- Tier H by path (`docs/adr/**`): the PR is a draft, `mergeable: true`; the approver's hand is the maintainer's. Not this record's to arm.
- Check-runs on the head at record time: every completed run is success or skipped (Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, every Lint and Type Check job, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate); `Test Core (1/8)` was still `in_progress` when this record was rendered — a core test shard that no docs line can red; landing rule ② (all checks green) is read again at queue time, not here.

### ④ Design judgment

**`docs/adr/0050-form-layout-vs-presentation.md` against its first consumer and its execution plan.**

- *The status is true of the tree.* Spec half (#27155 → PR #27229, merged 2026-10-28T12:16Z, merge commit `14e9685fc9`): on `main`, `view.zod.ts` L5151–5156 declares `type: enumWithRetiredValues(['simple','tabbed','wizard'], FORM_VIEW_TYPE_RETIRED).default('simple')`, with tombstones for `split` / `drawer` / `modal` naming ADR-0050 and `@objectstack/spec 18.3.0` (L4997–5016), and `section.pane`, `splitSize`, `splitResizable` retired with `split` (L3919, L4455, L5020–5029). Renderer half (#27159 → PR #27305, merged 2026-10-29T09:40Z, `a33fce29`): `SplitForm.tsx` is gone from `ui/packages/plugin-form/src`, `ObjectForm.tsx` has no `split` / `drawer` / `modal` branch, and the drawer/modal arms live in `ObjectFormContainer.tsx` as caller-supplied containers — the shape ruling A′ ordered. Both cutover cards are closed `completed`. "Accepted" describes the live tree, not a plan.
- *The line parses and the ruled sentence is intact.* The dev kept the old amendment clause (`· **Amended** (2026-10-20, letter B′ on #24692, ruling record 6281834942, maintainer 「同意」) — …`) after the ruled sentence. Judged right, not a deviation: the ruled sentence itself says "the 2026-10-20 amendment stands", and the retained clause is the only place the record links where that amendment was ruled (Prime Directive 13: a standing amendment stays traceable). The keyword read is unaffected (`Accepted` at index 0; `Amended` outside the 80-char window), the first ISO date is the ruling date, and the generator's row shows the ruled sentence, not the amendment. The redundancy ("amendment stands · Amended (…)") is cosmetic.
- *Should-fix (outside this PR's claim, for a follow-up card, not a FAIL):* the body's Migration ("spec-major: the removed values are a breaking surface change") and Consequences / Sequencing ("implementation is a spec-major change") still describe the cutover as spec-major, while ruling A′ (6464210455) shipped it as an 18.3.0 `(narrowing)` minor because this repository has no spec-major window (AGENTS.md L1084–1090). The status line cites that ruling record, so the fact is reachable, and the card (#26553 done-when) and the claim's file surface (6688244732: "status line :3 only, ⛔ any other ADR body text") forbid touching the body in this PR. A one-line dated note under Migration, in the shape of the 2026-10-20 note under Decision 2, would close the gap; it is not this PR's to add.
- Tried to break: a status value with the keyword past the window, a second vocabulary word earlier than `Accepted`, a link whose text changes the cut — none applies; `Accepted` is the first token after `**Status**: ` and every link sits beyond the 64-char cut.

**`docs/adr/README.md` against its generator.** Generated output, judged only for being the generator's: the three hunks (two summary counts, one row) are exactly what `renderIndex` produces for the one changed record (derivation in ①), the banner and every other row are untouched, and the head's report-only CI step raised no stale-index warning. Holds.

No must-fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-uz8dqb`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibzzqHZdAVqgBAvxXKB`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0050 状态行从 Proposed 改为 Accepted，开头逐字使用 #26553 指针 6464456446 规定的句子（裁决 A′，#27032 裁决记录 6464210455；切换卡 #27155 + #27159）。原有 2026-10-20 修订说明及其链接保留在后面。`docs/adr/README.md` 由 `pnpm adr:index` 重新生成：Proposed 5→4，Accepted 130→131。
- 为什么改：19 条过期 Proposed ADR 已全部裁决，只剩 ADR-0050 的状态行没落地。读 ADR 索引的人和从 ADR-0050 切出的卡看到的还是 Proposed。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档两行状态，不发布任何包（`skip-changeset`）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0050-form-layout-vs-presentation.md` 第 3 行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check`，预期 exit 0。
- 需要你做的：Tier H（`docs/adr/**`）。请以 os-zhuang 批准 PR #30986，批准后席位落地。契约复审 PASS 记录 6688923854，Head-sha `ac204886c44d6e03cc7bb775094e5145ae0a58c7`。

席位意见：可以落地，待授权批准。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:spec#1` · head `ac204886` · 2026-11-06T15:47Z

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #26553`, draft, base `main`, 2 files (`docs/adr/0050-form-layout-vs-presentation.md` :3, regenerated `docs/adr/README.md`), +4/−4. Label `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching claim 6688244732.
2. **Ruling:** pointer 6464456446 (ADR-0050 ruled A′ on #27032, ruling 6464210455, maintainer 「其他同意」). The ruled sentence comes first verbatim. The dev kept the 2026-10-20 amendment clause after it; the ruled sentence says the amendment stands, so the seat accepts this.
3. **Contract review:** at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by an isolated reviewer. Scope = hits (both ADR files) plus `scripts/adr-index.mjs`, `view.zod.ts` `FormViewSchema.type`, and the plugin-form renderer. PASS 6688923854 on `ac204886`, no must-fix. Its findings:
   - The index row and counts are byte-for-byte the generator's output.
   - Keyword `Accepted` parses first.
   - Both cutover halves are on main (PR #27229, PR #27305), so "Accepted" is true of the tree.
   - One should-fix outside this PR's file surface: the ADR body's Migration and Consequences text still says "spec-major", while A′ shipped an 18.3.0 `(narrowing)` minor. The seat will carry it as a follow-up and not widen this PR.
4. **Gates / check-runs:** dev: 21 of 21 derived gates exit 0, `--ran` reconciled (report 6688746866). On head `ac204886`: 46 runs, 26 success, 20 skipped, 0 failed, 0 running (docs-only diff, path filters skip the code lanes); mergeable_state clean. `check-governed-merges --pr 30986`: Tier H (`docs/adr/**` ×2), 8 changed lines.
5. **Accepted deviations:** amendment clause kept after the ruled sentence (see 2). Neighbour PRs #30828, #30862, #30899 and #30940 touch other `docs/adr` records; none touches README.md. The later lander re-runs `pnpm adr:index` after merging main.
6. **Landing:** Tier H: `pm:awaiting-merge` + review requested from the approvers. ⛔ No ready, queue or auto-merge before an APPROVED review from a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account; after it, the seat lands.
